programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Mahavinashak engulfs Vrindavan in deadly magical sand, defeating Krishna’s allies and threatening total destruction. As Kans schemes to lure Krishna into the open, the villagers, guided by faith, pray to Goddess Shakambari for protection. Through divine will, Mahavinashak is destroyed by his own ultimate weapon, restoring peace to Vrindavan. Yet Kans and Mahisasur continue plotting, ensuring that future dangers still loom despite the village’s renewed faith and unity.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna is lovingly raised in Vrindavan, where harmony with nature and equality define village life. As Kans and Shukracharya plot his downfall by resurrecting the seemingly invincible Mahishasur—who hides his life and immortality in three magical flowers—danger quietly spreads. Disguised, Mahishasur targets Krishna’s loved ones to break him. Amid contests that celebrate intelligence, teamwork, and gender equality, Krishna protects Vrindavan through wit, illusion, and unity. False claims of Krishna’s death and rising terror test the villagers’ faith, but divine protection prevails. The threat escalates toward a cosmic resolution, as only divine feminine power can ultimately defeat Mahishasur.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna protects Vrindavan through divine illusion as repeated asur threats arise. When Mahishasura, immune to men, endangers the realms, Radha—empowered by Goddess Jagdambika—defeats him, proving women’s strength and saving the village during Sharad Poonam. Amid celebrations, Krishna’s playful leelas spark love, conflict, and social reform, while darker dangers loom with Netrasur, Bhasmasur, and new enemies threatening Vrindavan once more.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Netrasur, an asur descended from Bhasmasur, terrorizes Brindavan by shrinking its residents and threatening Krishna with ash-turning powers inherited from a dangerous divine boon. With help from Yaksh Kumaar, Krishna protects his friends and prioritizes their safety, even as Netrasur sets traps and demands obedience. Parallel intrigues unfold—Kansa schemes to revive Bhasmasur using sacred ashes, prophecies surrounding Prema’s marriage expose greed and destiny manipulation, and Shiva warns of cosmic imbalance without directly intervening. Through wit and deception, Krishna turns Netrasur’s own power against him, restoring all victims and reestablishing harmony in Brindavan. Festivities resume amid Diwali preparations, moral lessons on greed and reform are reinforced through a theft subplot, and while peace returns, unresolved conspiracies foreshadow greater trials ahead.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: During Diwali preparations in Vrindavan, repeated thefts create fear and suspicion among the villagers, with Madhumangal and Radha wrongly accused. Through divine tests and Krishna’s guidance, it is revealed that the real cause is Lobhasur, a demon born of greed, who manipulates minds and spreads desire. As Kans exploits the chaos to accuse Nand Baba of treason and threaten Vrindavan, Krishna resolves to confront the source of greed to protect the village and restore dharma.

programme.title: Dalua Downhill
programme.desc: This is the journey of Douglas Rodrigues da Silva, aka “Dalua”, who is in search of the Downhill Skateboard world championship. This sport is among the most dangerous in the world where the skaters go downhill reaching speeds over 110 km/h. Over the course of two years, the film follows the Brazilian athlete in his travels around the world revealing that beyond the competition there is a story of determination, passion, pressure and pain. Friendship and rivalry awake some rowdy feelings between the athletes. It is this common bond between them that also what keeps them apart.

programme.title: Dalua Downhill
programme.desc: This is the journey of Douglas Rodrigues da Silva, aka “Dalua”, who is in search of the Downhill Skateboard world championship. This sport is among the most dangerous in the world where the skaters go downhill reaching speeds over 110 km/h. Over the course of two years, the film follows the Brazilian athlete in his travels around the world revealing that beyond the competition there is a story of determination, passion, pressure and pain. Friendship and rivalry awake some rowdy feelings between the athletes. It is this common bond between them that also what keeps them apart.
